a deep ebony-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, soft and heavy and slack; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, her waist lost beneath the folds, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, waist-length braids platinum silver hair — wearing nothing but a liquid silver chrome micro bikini: a tiny molded top with a centre zip pulled halfway down and an ultra micro bikini bottom tied with thin side strings, the mirror-bright metal catching every reflection around her, every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, plain bare real skin. The outfit reflects the surrounding mirrors in soft highlights, her skin tone running naturally everywhere else. Background: a mirrored cube room with mirrors on all four walls, the ceiling and a glossy black floor, thin hot-pink neon LED strips running along every corner so the pink lines multiply into an endless glowing lattice in all directions, her figure repeated in the lattice from every side, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus, lit by the pink neon and soft light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
